name: Churches of Peace in Jawor and Świdnica
description: Tucked outside the old town walls of Jawor and Świdnica in Lower Silesia, these two Lutheran churches are the largest timber-framed religious buildings in Europe. Built in the 1650s from wood, loam and straw, with no steeples or bells, they look plain outside. Inside, they burst with Baroque paintings, including 180 biblical scenes in Jawor.
